annotations.title: Get AI Brand Radar scan status

description: Status of a Brand Radar scan started by run_brand_radar_scan, by its `jobId`. `status` is queued/running/complete/errored; a complete scan carries the shaped `result` (share of voice, top cited pages, top prompts), an errored one carries `error.message`. FREE to poll: a completed scan re-reads the cached result and charges nothing. The one exception is a scan whose cached result has already expired (older than ~24h) — answering that re-runs the lookup and is charged and rate limited like a new scan, so collect results promptly. Use this instead of re-running run_brand_radar_scan, which always spends another monthly scan.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID the scan was run for.

name: get_brand_radar_scan_status
